keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Searched against opportunity title/description. Defaults to "contract" so a first test run never returns 0 rows.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: Filter to one or more 6-digit NAICS codes, e.g. 541511.

setAsideTypes.title: Set-aside types
setAsideTypes.description: Filter to SAM.gov set-aside codes, e.g. SBA (total small business).

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Which SAM.gov notice types to include. All types if left empty.

organizationId.title: Organization ID
organizationId.description: SAM.gov internal organization ID to filter to one agency/office (advanced; find via a search result's organizationHierarchy).

activeOnly.title: Active opportunities only
activeOnly.description: Only return opportunities SAM.gov currently flags active.

enrichDetail.title: Enrich with detail call
enrichDetail.description: Make one extra request per opportunity to add NAICS codes, set-aside, place-of-performance state/country and point-of-contact (name/email/phone, published by the agency itself as part of the public notice). Slower.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many opportunities. SAM.gov's own search backend caps result depth at 10,000 for any single query — narrow keyword/filters to go deeper.
